# Summary

This script summarizes IgG antibody responses to Onchocerciasis ov16 and rp17 & tmpa antigens among children in the ECoMiD birth cohort for a supplemental figure in the manuscript. 

# Preamble

```{r preamble}
library(here)
here()
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
source(here("R","0-config.R"))
library(patchwork)

```

# Load the clean MBA data

```{r load antibody data}
#-------------------------------
# load the formatted MBA data
# for EcoMID, created by
# 0-all_sero_results_dataclean.Rmd
#
# data are in long format
#-------------------------------
d <- read_rds(here("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EcoMID/data/serology/final/ecomid_serology_datasets","ecomid_sero_antigen_seropos_long_v02_20261007.rds"))

# drop monitoring targets
d1 <- d %>%
  filter( !antigen %in% c("gst","monitor","vero"))
```

```{r load child visit data}
#-------------------------------
# load child visit data for
# exact dates at age of DBS collection
#-------------------------------
dvisit <- read_rds(file=here("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EcoMID/data/ecomid-field/final","ecomid_child_visit_info_2026-06-15.rds"))

#-------------------------------
# join visit ages to serology
# data and create a final age
# variable
#-------------------------------
d2 <- d1 %>%
  left_join(dvisit, join_by("community","community_name","childid","timepoint"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(age_days = case_when(
    !is.na(agedays_dbs) ~ agedays_dbs,
    is.na(agedays_dbs) & !is.na(agedays_stool) ~ agedays_stool,
    is.na(agedays_dbs) & is.na(agedays_stool) ~ agedays_svy,
    TRUE ~ NA
  ),
    # there are 2 children with visits that don't appear in the childvisit data
    # for them, it is both at 12 months, so assume age is DOB + 365 days
    agedays = ifelse(is.na(age_days), difftime(time1=dob, time2=dob + 365, units="days"), age_days), 
  age_months = age_days/30.4,
  age_years = age_days/365.25
           
           )
```

# MFI by age

## Oncho

Plot Oncho ov16 for the 4 children who were seropositive to both at some point during follow-up.
```{r}
#-------------------------------
dct_ov16 <- d2 %>%
  filter(antigen == "ov16")
#-------------------------------
# pivot the MFI and seropos
# values to wide format by sample
#-------------------------------
dct2_ov16 <- dct_ov16 %>%
  select(community_type,sampleid,childid,timepoint, age_months, antigen,log10mfi,seropos) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("community_type","sampleid","childid","timepoint","age_months"),
              names_from = "antigen",values_from=c("log10mfi","seropos"))
#-------------------------------
# identify when children first became positive to ov16
#-------------------------------
firstpos_ov16 <- dct2_ov16 %>%
  filter(seropos_ov16==1) %>%
  group_by(childid) %>%
  mutate(firstpos = min(timepoint),
         firstpos = paste0("Age ",firstpos," months"),
         firstpos = factor(firstpos, levels=paste0("Age ",c(6,9,12,18,24)," months"))
  ) %>%
  select(childid,firstpos) %>%
  distinct()
nrow(firstpos_ov16) # n children ever positive to ov16
```

## Yaws 
```{r}
#-------------------------------
# filter to the two Yaws antigens
#-------------------------------
dct_yaws <- d2 %>%
  filter(antigen %in% c("rp17","tmpa"))
#-------------------------------
# pivot the MFI and seropos
# values to wide format by sample
#-------------------------------
dct2_yaws <- dct_yaws %>%
  select(community_type,sampleid,childid,timepoint, age_months, antigen,log10mfi,seropos) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("community_type","sampleid","childid","timepoint","age_months"),
              names_from = "antigen",values_from=c("log10mfi","seropos")) %>%
  # create a joint seropositivity indicator - positive to BOTH at the SAME timepoint
  mutate(seropos_rp17tmpa = ifelse(seropos_rp17==1 & seropos_tmpa==1,1,0)) %>%
  # everpos = 1 if the child was ever positive to both simultaneously, at any visit
  group_by(childid) %>%
  mutate(everpos = max(seropos_rp17tmpa, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
#-------------------------------
# identify children ever positive to both, and
# when they first became jointly positive
#-------------------------------
firstpos_yaws <- dct2_yaws %>%
  filter(seropos_rp17tmpa==1) %>%
  group_by(childid) %>%
  mutate(firstpos = min(timepoint),
         firstpos = paste0("Age ",firstpos," months"),
         firstpos = factor(firstpos, levels=paste0("Age ",c(6,9,12,18,24)," months"))
  ) %>%
  select(childid,firstpos) %>%
  distinct()
nrow(firstpos_yaws) # n children ever jointly positive to rp17 and tmpa
```

## Shared labels
```{r}
 #-------------------------------
# force the overlapping children (AB8013, AB8014) to be
# labeled first, so they line up on the left in both panels;
# remaining children get the next codes.
# the label prefix is mapped from the child's 2-letter ID
# prefix (e.g., "AB" -> "R", "BB" -> "B") - add more entries
# to id_prefix_map below if other prefixes show up in your data
#-------------------------------
id_prefix_map <- c("AB" = "R", "BB" = "B")

overlap_ids     <- c("AB8013")
other_ov16_ids  <- sort(setdiff(firstpos_ov16$childid, overlap_ids))
other_yaws_ids  <- sort(setdiff(firstpos_yaws$childid, overlap_ids))
ordered_ids <- c(overlap_ids, other_ov16_ids, other_yaws_ids)

child_label_lookup <- tibble(childid = ordered_ids) %>%
  mutate(id_prefix    = substr(childid, 1, 2),
         label_prefix = id_prefix_map[id_prefix],
         childid_plot = paste0(label_prefix, "-", sprintf("%03d", row_number()))) %>%
  select(childid, childid_plot)
child_label_lookup
# sanity check: flag any child whose 2-letter ID prefix isn't yet in id_prefix_map
child_label_lookup %>% filter(is.na(childid_plot))
```
## Final plotting dataframes

```{r}
dct3_ov16 <- dct2_ov16 %>%
  filter(childid %in% firstpos_ov16$childid) %>%
  left_join(firstpos_ov16, join_by(childid)) %>%
  left_join(child_label_lookup, join_by(childid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log10mfi_ov16))

dct3_yaws <- dct2_yaws %>%
  filter(everpos==1) %>%
  left_join(firstpos_yaws, join_by(childid)) %>%
  left_join(child_label_lookup, join_by(childid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log10mfi_rp17) | !is.na(log10mfi_tmpa))

ov16_levels <- child_label_lookup %>% filter(childid %in% firstpos_ov16$childid) %>% pull(childid_plot)
yaws_levels <- child_label_lookup %>% filter(childid %in% firstpos_yaws$childid) %>% pull(childid_plot)

plot_data_ov16 <- dct3_ov16 %>%
  select(childid_plot, age_months, log10mfi_ov16) %>%
  mutate(childid_plot = factor(childid_plot, levels = ov16_levels))

plot_data_yaws <- dct3_yaws %>%
  select(childid_plot, age_months, log10mfi_rp17, log10mfi_tmpa) %>%
  mutate(childid_plot = factor(childid_plot, levels = yaws_levels))
```

## Composite Plot

```{r}
ov16cut  <- log10(d2$mficut[d2$antigen=="ov16"][1])
rp17cut  <- log10(d2$mficut[d2$antigen=="rp17"][1])
tmpacut  <- log10(d2$mficut[d2$antigen=="tmpa"][1])

# Panel A: Oncho (ov16), 4 children, one row
plot_ov16_mfi <- ggplot(plot_data_ov16, aes(x=age_months)) +
  facet_wrap(~childid_plot, nrow = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ov16cut, lty="dashed", lwd=0.2, color=cbpal[8]) +
  geom_line(aes(y=log10mfi_ov16), alpha = 0.9, color=cbpal[8]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(6,9,12,18,24)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(6,24),ylim=c(0,4.5)) +
  labs(x = "Age in months", y="log10 IgG Luminex response (MFI-bg)",
       subtitle="Oncho (Ov16)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Panel B: Yaws (rp17 and tmpa), 3 real children, one row
plot_yaws_mfi <- ggplot(plot_data_yaws, aes(x=age_months)) +
  facet_wrap(~childid_plot, nrow = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = rp17cut, lty="dashed", lwd=0.2, color=cbpal[4]) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = tmpacut, lty="dashed", lwd=0.2, color=cbpal[1]) +
  geom_line(aes(y=log10mfi_rp17, color="Rp17"), alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_line(aes(y=log10mfi_tmpa, color="TmpA"), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(6,9,12,18,24)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(6,24),ylim=c(0,4.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(name=NULL, values=c(Rp17=cbpal[4], TmpA=cbpal[1])) +
  labs(x = "Age in months", y="log10 IgG Luminex response (MFI-bg)",
       subtitle="Yaws (Rp17 and TmpA)") +
  theme_minimal()

# pad the Yaws row with a true blank spacer (1 panel's worth of width)
# so it visually aligns with Oncho's row of 4
plot_yaws_row <- plot_yaws_mfi + guide_area() +
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1), guides = "collect")

plot_composite <- (plot_ov16_mfi / plot_yaws_row) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
plot_composite

ggsave(filename = here("output","ecomid-longtrajectories-oncho-yaws-composite.png"),
       plot = plot_composite, device = "png", width = 220, height = 160, units = "mm")

# ggsave(filename = here("output","figureS1-ecomid-longtrajectories-oncho-yaws-composite.tiff"), plot_composite, device = "tiff", width = 220, height = 160, units = "mm")
```
